grammar: field kinds: see the generator header. Data = the fields of `local` or `remote` (by the packet local flag); `full` never changes a format in this build (no mirror field is flagged 0x20, no reader tests it for bits).

types.name: STUStatescriptStateStack
notes: stack_priority: node m_priority (+0x108) set and not a STUConfigVarStackPriority

verified_live.example: Stack idle: no predecessor, on top

types.name: STUStatescriptStateEffect
notes: low 2 bits of the state serial; the client class has no writer (+0x1F0 is the no-op)
client writer/reader asymmetry: the client never writes this data; a client-side serialization of it (Prometheus ss_serialize_local) is not what the reader expects
